decks.notes: The deck focuses on deploying disruptive creatures quickly to control the board and slow down the opponent's game plan. This UWx Control deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The deck utilizes cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Narset, Parter of Veils to disrupt the opponent's strategy while also drawing cards with Brainstorm and Ponder. Supreme Verdict and Gideon, Ally of Zendikar provide board control, while Teferi, Time Raveler helps to protect key cards and disrupt the opponent's plays. Shark Typhoon offers a win condition, and the inclusion of Day's Undoing and The Wandering Emperor provide additional card advantage and utility.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly assemble a combo using cards like Lion's Eye Diamond and Echo of Eons to generate mana and draw cards, while also utilizing artifacts like Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Bauble to trigger abilities and dig deeper into the deck. By efficiently cycling through the deck and managing resources carefully, the deck aims to combo off and win the game in a explosive burst of action.
